title: AAPS 2.8.2 change language will not change it
symptom: After changing the language from 'System default' to German in AAPS settings, the interface remains in French even after restarting AAPS.
cause: The thread does not identify a specific root cause, but suggests it is a recurring bug that has existed for a long time.
fix: Select 'System default' in AAPS settings and change the language in the Android settings instead.
evidence_quote: Select System default in AAPS settings and change language in your android setting, then it works perfectly.
